rachel_csm: Heads-up Silverleaf trial: token spend +20% and p95 on /complete creeping to ~900ms at peak. Theyre worried about renewal. Thinking a conservative plan: phased canary to compact-int8 + scheduled routing for daily surge window.
omar_ml: Do we have tail numbers and timing?
rachel_csm: p50 ~140ms -> 260ms, p95 ~900ms, p99 ~1450ms. Peak 16:00-16:30 UTC. ~27% of calls include long policy text (~3k tokens).
tess_se: Hosted trial? Any committed spend?
rachel_csm: Hosted, no commit. Renewal signal = medium  need low-risk path.
omar_ml: Proposal (short): 1) Enable prefix KV caching for repeated policies. 2) 5% canary compact-13b-int8 for non-sensitive routes (24h). 3) Schedule routing to compact-13b-int8 during 16:00-16:30 with fallback to open-13b-fp16. 4) Dark-launch mirror for rerank endpoints first if they want zero user impact.
rachel_csm: Can we give them a phased plan and a tiny routing snippet they can paste? Also include rollback gates.
omar_ml: Phases: A: telemetry + caching 48h. B: mirror 10% candidate for 24h (collect diffs). C: live canary 5% for 24h with auto-gates. D: increase to 30-50% and enable scheduled routing during peak. Gates: embeddings cosine >= 0.975, NDCG drop < 1%, p95 not worse than baseline.
tess_se: I'll author runbook and dashboards. Minimal routing snippet they can paste into Console: ```{ "route": "silverleaf-prod/complete", "schedule": [{"when":"16:00-16:30","preferred":"compact-13b-int8","fallback":"open-13b-fp16"}], "canary": {"model":"compact-13b-int8","pct":5} }```
ops-bot: Note: reserved-pool bindings require billing approval. Changes to reserved pools will open a finance PR.
rachel_csm: Perfect. I'll assemble the one-pager + risk note and offer a 30m enablement call tomorrow. Omar: can you run a 5k sim and post rough numbers in ~3h?
omar_ml: On it. Quick back-of-envelope: int8 often reduces token compute ~25-30%; for long contexts expect p95 to drop ~25-40% on canary. Will validate with sim.
rachel_csm: Thanks team. No blockers noted.
